title: PLACEHOLDER reactor grammar and consumer-route review
mode: Deeper/broader primary-source research and implementation-plan refinement
scope: Resolve the group-330 scope ambiguity in the WDFLT default PLACEHOLDER route
Compare normative DXF documentation with an independent DXF parser/resource copier
Keep FreeCAD DXF importer and DWG converter qualification routes separate
Convert evidence into a bounded implementation sequence without promoting support

method.kind: Read Autodesk DXF object/common-code tables, ezdxf source/docs, FreeCAD importer docs/source, and local writer/preflight code
method.limitations: Autodesk tables establish published DXF structure but do not resolve the semantic target/cardinality ambiguity for the PLACEHOLDER scoped code-330 entry beyond their stated description. ezdxf and FreeCAD sources were not executed. No local DWG-origin PLACEHOLDER receipt or native semantic result was produced. ODA's version-specific DWG layout and a real repository/local trace remain prerequisites for broader admission.

sources.observed: ACDBPLACEHOLDER documents a handle, persistent-reactor group scope with an in-scope code-330 soft pointer, and a required trailing code-330 owner. The common-object table says reactor groups are optional when persistent reactors are attached. Group code alone is insufficient to distinguish target from owner; group-102 context is required.

sources.revision: Mutable current source and documentation read 2026-10-18; no commit or package artifact pinned
sources.observed: DXFEntity setup/export treats ACAD_REACTORS as a distinct appdata structure, writes reactors before owner, and maps reactor handles as soft pointers when copying. The xref documentation states unsupported proxy/raw objects and many OBJECTS features are ignored, constraining use as a semantic comparator.

sources.revision: Mutable current main documentation and source read 2026-10-18; no native build or converter run
sources.observed: FreeCAD documents multiple DXF importers, current inability to read ACIS/SAT blobs, and a DWG route that first invokes an external converter before DXF import. Conversion success and native 3D acceptance are separate evidence stages.

observed: writeAcDbPlaceholder delegates reactor serialization to writeTableEntryAppData and separately writes the required owner.
The typed DWG-origin WDFLT preflight currently refuses PLACEHOLDER reactors.
The raw DXF-origin preflight counts code-330 tags flatly and requires exactly one, so any scoped reactor code-330 is refused.
The raw receipt validator accepts reactor marker tokens but does not validate their complete ordered scope structure.
The graph walker stages a default PLACEHOLDER handle but does not visit its reactor targets.

assessment.existingSubplanRefined: WDFLT / ACDBPLACEHOLDER reactor closure and group-330 scope validation
assessment.planImpact: Makes PLACEHOLDER reactor admission context-sensitive and fail-closed, adds an explicit graph-closure requirement, limits the first implementation slice to already-admitted targets, and separates DXF converter success from FreeCAD ACIS/3D semantic qualification. No new local defect or support evidence is claimed.

implementationReadyChecks: Parse raw 102 scopes in order and distinguish in-scope reactor pointers from the required final owner pointer.
Do not infer the PLACEHOLDER reactor target or repeat cardinality from generic reactors alone; check the ODA versioned layout and an actual repository/local trace before broadening.
Require every admitted typed/raw reactor reference to resolve to exactly one object in the emitted closure and verify output remapping in ASCII and Binary generated controls.
Keep unsupported application data, XDATA, extension dictionaries, unknown targets, and malformed scopes rejected atomically.
Run the touched adapter build and focused WDFLT CTest only; keep native CAD, peer runtime, and full suites at the composed gate.
Do not import or commit external drawings.
